scope: Cast-exclusive and Great Ape skill taxonomy reconciliation

corrections.name: Boulder Break
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Bardock
corrections.reason: Current sources establish Boulder Break as a Super Skill used by Great Apes; its physical boulder-slam behavior supports Strike taxonomy. Cost remains unresolved.

corrections.name: Boulder Toss
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Vegeta
corrections.reason: Current sources establish Boulder Toss as the physical rock-throw Super Skill used by Great Apes; cost remains unresolved.

corrections.name: Energy Cannon
corrections.reason: Retain Ki Blast classification and cast-only status; no reliable numeric Ki-cost evidence was found.

corrections.name: Beam Rifle
corrections.reason: Retain Ki Blast classification and cast-only status; no reliable numeric Ki-cost evidence was found.

corrections.name: Bloody Sauce

previous_values.unlock_method: Expert Mission 13: History of Mixed Battles

corrections.reason: Dedicated skill documentation lists Expert Mission 20 as the unlock; Mission 13 separately lists the Raid variant.

notes: Gigantic Slam and Bloody Sauce were absent from the canonical catalog and are therefore represented as new records, not corrections. Boulder Break, Boulder Toss, Energy Cannon, and Beam Rifle are retained as formal corrections to Batch 283. Giant Storm is intentionally not included because it is an Ultimate Skill and will be handled in the appropriate Ultimate catalog.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.character_source: Broly; Broly (Supervillain); Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) Customize Partner
records.effect: Grab the opponent and slam them down with a Ki Wave; leaves the user open.

records.name: Bloody Sauce
records.character_source: Supervillain and boss characters; Time Patroller use restricted to Crystal Raid or Training
